notes.title: Update 1.0.13 - new achievements + bug fix
notes.notes:
Hi,

there was quite a lot of activity on the servers this weekend and this brought a bug into the light:
Some of you may have noticed that when connecting a server that is running non official maps, after the map is downloaded from the server it happened that the game was crashing. This should be now fixed. What happened was simply that the downloaded file was corrupted during the download, depending on the network conditions ...

If you still encounter this issue after this update, don't hesitate to post in the bug reports part of the forum.

notes.title: Update 1.0.12 - Online leaderboard !
notes.notes:
Hi there,

Quite a long time with no update so here comes a new one !
This update features mainly a brand new online ranking system. Basically each time you play on the official online servers, the outcome of the match will be used to determine your skill level ( using the trueskill algorythm ). This works versus human players but also versus bots.

467 bots with unique characteristics have been created and are playing on the online servers. Their stats and skill are persisted the same way as for human players, so even if you can't find anyone playing online, you can still play versus the bots to increase your skill and your online rank.

Will you be able to beat the bots ?

The leaderboard is available in the game but also on the official website:
http://www.daedalus-thegame.com/leaderboard.php

http://www.daedalus-thegame.com/images/leaderboard.png

Another little update is that when respawning, you are now invisible to the bots during one second and a half. This prevents the bots from spawn killing !

With this update comes a new dedicated server available here:
http://www.daedalus-thegame.com/download/servers/daedalus-server-1.0.12.jar

I hope you will like this update and will visit the online servers a bit more often ;)

Cheers,
Patrice.

notes.title: Update 1.0.7 ... instagib + demo !
notes.notes:
hey,

Thanks a lot to everybody participating on the forum ! There are a lot of great ideas discussed, and this update is bringing to life 2 of them: instagib and dark arena modifiers. 

Changelog 1.0.7

instagib modifier in singleplayer and multi: option available in all the game modes that allows to kill in one shot using a modified railgun ( more powerful and with a faster firerate )
dark arena modifier in singleplayer and multi: option available in all the game modes to turn off the lights in the maps ... allows crazy fights in the dark!
separated player speed and bot speed options in skirmish
fixes classic control mode aiming issue when crosshair close to the player
loading indicator at startup

I hope you will like these changes, as always don't hesitate to comment the new options in the forum !

Demo
Until now the demo of Daedalus - No Escape was available only on the official website, and the issue was that a lot of players were not aware of its existence. This is now fixed, the demo is available directly on steam! Try it if you want to see the game in action before spending your money on it ;)

cheers,
Patrice.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2 Available
notes.notes:
Hi,

the version 1.0.2 is now available. Here is the changelog:
- gamepad support (XBOX 360 only)
- new high refresh rate display option, to support monitors with a frequency > 60Hz
- fixed memory issues, plus various bugs in the editor
- fixed error reading local score file at startup
- fixed various minor issues (typo ...)

The gamepad support is brand new, it has been successfully tested on windows and Linux. If you have a mac with a xbox 360 controller and it's not working in the game (but it's working in other games), please post a message on the forum.

The gamepad support is generic and more controllers can be supported via config file. I'll post a guide soon on how to create them.

cheers
